title: Nouns: Gender and Number
subtitle: Singular and plural formation. Most plurals add -s (silent); nouns in -eau, -au, -eu add -x. Irregulars: œil/yeux, travail/travaux.
objectives: Form the plural of regular French nouns.
Recognize plural patterns for nouns ending in -eau, -au, -eu.
Understand that the plural -s is silent.

sections.heading: Regular plural formation
sections.body:
Most French nouns form the plural by adding -s to the singular. The -s is silent.

Singular → Plural:
  le livre → les livres (the book → the books)
  la maison → les maisons (the house → the houses)
  un homme → des hommes (a man → men)

The plural is marked in writing but not in speech. The article and the verb are what signal plurality.

sections.heading: Nouns ending in -s, -x, -z
sections.body:
Nouns that already end in -s, -x, or -z in the singular do not change in the plural.

  le fils → les fils (the son → the sons)
  la voix → les voix (the voice → the voices)
  le nez → les nez (the nose → the noses)

The singular and plural forms are identical.

sections.heading: Nouns ending in -eau, -au, -eu
sections.body:
Nouns ending in -eau, -au, or -eu add -x instead of -s in the plural.

  le bateau → les bateaux (the boat → the boats)
  le château → les châteaux (the castle → the castles)
  le jeu → les jeux (the game → the games)

The -x is silent, like the -s.

sections.heading: Nouns ending in -al
sections.body:
Most nouns ending in -al change to -aux in the plural.

  le cheval → les chevaux (the horse → the horses)
  le journal → les journaux (the newspaper → the newspapers)

A few exceptions keep -al → -als, but they are rare.

sections.heading: Irregular plurals
sections.body:
A handful of nouns have irregular plurals that must be memorized.

  l'œil → les yeux (the eye → the eyes)
  le travail → les travaux (the work → the works)
  madame → mesdames (madam → madams)
  monsieur → messieurs (sir → sirs)

These are common nouns. Learn them by ear.

sections.heading: Plural in literary French
sections.body:
From La Fontaine's Fables:

  Les animaux malades de la peste
  (The animals sick with the plague)

Here 'animaux' is the plural of 'animal'. Notice the -al → -aux pattern.
